description: Abstract class for visiting and rendering XML widget elements, including attributes, images, links, and parameters within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: XmlAbstractWidgetVisitor
classes.description: Abstract class providing methods to generate XML representations of widgets, images, links, and parameters in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns the Appendable writer used for output.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Overloaded methods to write different types of attribute values to the writer.

methods.name: visitAutoEntityParameters
methods.description: Placeholder for visiting auto entity parameters.

methods.name: visitAutoServiceParameters
methods.description: Placeholder for visiting auto service parameters.

methods.name: visitImage
methods.description: Generates XML for an image element with attributes.

methods.name: visitLink
methods.description: Generates XML for a link element, including nested images and parameters.

methods.name: visitModelWidget
methods.description: Writes the name attribute of a widget if present.

methods.name: visitParameters
methods.description: Generates XML for a collection of parameters.
